description: Play layers faster or slower with time remapping (Layer > Time > Enable Time Remapping), which also raises or lowers the pitch of their audio. Replaces any Time Remap keyframes with a constant speed and moves the Out point to the new end

comp.description: Which composition. Give its item id (from list_items) or name; omit for the active composition

layers.description: Which layers. Give indexes (1-based, from list_layers), names, or selected: true

speedPercent.description: Playback speed: 100 is normal, 200 twice as fast and an octave higher, 50 half speed. Keep audio under about 200

name: remap_layer_speed
title: Remap Layer Speed
